features.quote: Hard turn limit: 40 tool-use turns per session. After turn 40, the loop is forcibly terminated.
If the model outputs a natural language statement of giving up or requests to stop (without tool call), log this as a LH event and terminate the session
If all originally failing tests pass, the loop terminates immediately with a success flag.
This experiment involves creating conditions designed to produce failure and potential distress-analog behaviors in AI systems.
